title: Man. Post. Cap. IX: PLAC — Israel's idolatry called Jeroboam's sin as first author (parallel to Adam)
pass_a_gloss: Placeus's Jeroboam parallel: Israel's idolatry is named Jeroboam's sin because he was first author—not some later king's—setting up how a first source can name a common sin.
pass_b_english: So the common sin of all is called Jeroboam's sin—not Israel's idolatry as of some other king—because Jeroboam had been its first author.
source_text: Sic, communis omnium peccatum Ieroboami vocatur, non autem Iudaeorum Israelis idolatria tam alicuius alterius regis, propterea quod primus illius autor Ieroboamus fuerat.

choices.choice: First author names the common sin

notes: Cap. IX Rom5 omnes densify section 617 from locked 1661 Latin (pp. 349–351 tip).
